chunks: And in the Nawadir of Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, it is narrated that al-Sadiq عليه السلام said:
"Severing the head of the deceased is more severe than severing the head of the living."

key_terms.أَشَدُّ: More severe or graver in ruling and seriousness
key_terms.قَطْعُ رَأْسِ الْمَيِّتِ: Severing the head of a deceased person
key_terms.قَطْعِ رَأْسِ الْحَيِّ: Severing the head of a living person

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about severing the head of a deceased person?
ai.summary: This hadith states that violating the body of a deceased person by severing the head is an especially grave matter. It underscores the sanctity and inviolability of the human body after death, which carries legal and moral significance in Islamic jurisprudence.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5356 - In Nawadir of Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, it is narrated that Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Beheading the dead is more severe than beheading the living."
